wiki.title: Elle Cochran
wiki.extract: Eleanora Kellett Cochran is an American politician who serves in the Hawaii House of Representatives representing the 14th district, which includes the areas of Wai'ehu, Waihe'e, Kahakuloa, Honokahua, Kahana, Mahinahina Camp, Ka'anapali, Lahaina, Lahainaluna, Olowalu and portions of Ma'alaea. She won the seat in the 2022 election as the Democratic nominee, but defected to the Republican Party in 2026.
